results.title: Characteristic-two orthogonal Hensel recovery
results.question: Recover tensor transporters under orthogonal group schemes over Z/2^eZ in polynomial bit time on a rigorously recognized large source class, accounting for nonsmooth special fibers.
results.result: Lift a prescribed mod-2 tensor and isometry transporter residue, retaining a compact description of the full compatible coset.

results.title: Sharp Gram spectral statistics in characteristic two
results.question: Determine asymptotic simple-primary-factor probabilities for the actual quadratic Gram operators of random tensors in characteristic two, uniformly over rectangular aspect ratios.
results.result: Give exact squarefree-spectrum probabilities for the standard characteristic-two dot-product Gram at every rectangular width.

results.title: Anchor-generation threshold for random restrictions
results.question: Determine the sharp rank threshold r(n,q) at which a low-rank tensor anchor together with its paired Gram operator generates the full endomorphism algebra with high probability.
results.result: Find the low-rank anchor threshold with joint spectral projectors and exact rank-one laws for squarefree spectra.

results.title: Orbit-closure intersection with unequal matrix sides at fixed width
results.question: Decide product-SL OCI for rational a-by-b-by-m tensors over C in polynomial bit time for every fixed m, with a and b independently varying and both potentially unbounded.
results.result: Classify rectangular two-slice product-SL orbit closures by one determinant or a trivial invariant ring.

results.title: Sharp Fourier transfer for tensor Gram ensembles
results.question: Determine optimal dimension-uniform Renyi-divergence bounds between actual alternating/Hermitian tensor Gram laws and their uniform matrix models, beyond the existing bounded second moment.
results.result: Compute exact densities and all Rényi divergences of alternating and Hermitian Gram laws for individual uniform tensor flattenings.

results.title: Square-zero commutant radicals with nonabelian tops
results.question: Extend P18 recovery to covariance commutants with square-zero radical and arbitrary semisimple top, without bounded block sizes or supplied Wedderburn frames.
results.result: Lift supplied classical top transporters through square-zero commutant radicals in all characteristics.

results.title: Exact tensor equivalence with sparse spectral support and growing blocks
results.question: Give polynomial-time O/U tensor equivalence when only O(N) spectral-block triples are nonzero but block dimensions grow, without bounded support-component size.
results.result: Give polynomial orthogonal and unitary transport with rational spectra and growing rank-one spectral blocks.

results.title: A monomial-equivariant dual partner
results.question: Construct an efficient code-valued rule F with the inverse coordinate-scaling covariance and invertible pairing required in the survey’s monomial reduction to weighted graph isomorphism, or prove no such rule satisfies the axioms on all codes.
results.result: Rule out a universal monomial-equivariant dual partner over every finite field and characterize the code orbits admitting one.

results.title: Length-preserving monomial equivalence across restriction of scalars
results.question: Recover a semilinear F_q-monomial transporter from one comparison of the underlying prime-field additive codes with blocks, allowing additive equivalences that can a priori mix basis coordinates in each field symbol.
results.result: Recover semilinear transport from additive block witnesses using chord subfields and compatible Frobenius exponents.

results.title: Equivalence of modules over nonsemisimple symbol alphabets
results.question: For linear codes over Z/p^eZ with unrestricted Smith type, classify monomial equivalence in polynomial bit time relative to equivalence of the residue and socle codes together with their lift data.
results.result: Find all diagonal lifts of a prescribed permutation over a chain ring with unrestricted Smith types.

results.title: Almost-uniform generation of kernels
results.question: Construct a polynomial-mixing output algorithm that samples approximately uniformly from all kernels K with G/K≅H using only an epimorphism decision oracle.
results.result: Sample exact uniform quotient kernels for targets that are products of nonabelian simple groups and arbitrary finite abelian groups.

results.title: Common-quotient optimization
results.question: Given Cayley tables G and H, determine the complexity of computing the largest order of a group admitting epimorphisms from both. Output a structure table and witnesses within time polynomial in the inputs.
results.result: Find a largest common odd-exponent-p quotient with commutator dimension at most one and output both quotient maps.

results.title: Compact completion of a cocycle from local restrictions
results.question: Prove a polynomial-bit algorithm for constructing a global 2-cocycle matching supplied restrictions to a generating family of subgroups, for variable modular modules given by generators and no enumeration of the whole quotient.
results.result: Extend exact local cocycles to a compact evaluator on an elementary abelian quotient with arbitrary same-characteristic action.

results.title: The smallest common permutation quotient of parallel representations
results.question: Given compact actions of the same abstract group on two unlabeled domains, find a minimum-size domain through which both admit a compatible faithful common extension, or give a complexity classification.
results.result: Optimize common refinements of two jointly faithful actions in polynomial time and prove NP-completeness for three.

results.title: Superlinear regular complexity of the ordinary determinant
results.question: Prove or refute that the least affine determinant representation of det_q with corank one at the zero input grows superlinearly in q.
results.result: Prove that every affine representation of the generic s-by-s determinant that has corank one at zero has size at least 1+ceil(s²/2).

results.title: Second-order jets of regular Koszul representations
results.question: Determine the minimum size of a regular affine determinant representation matching the unpadded Koszul form through second order in all its coefficient directions simultaneously at the identity coefficient matrix.
results.result: Determine the quadratic asymptotic size needed to match all second-order Koszul coefficient data under regularity.

results.title: Separating border factor degree from approximation order
results.question: Can a factor of degree d of a size-s border-circuit polynomial be represented by a size-poly(s,d,n) border circuit whose approximation order is bounded by a polynomial in the input approximation order and d?
results.result: Bound numerator and denominator parameter degrees in coprime factor lifting with circuit size independent of input parameter degree.

results.title: Canonical polystable degeneration
results.question: Can a rational tensor or polynomial be mapped to a canonical representative of its closed complex orbit in polynomial bit time?
results.result: Construct a canonical closed rational representative of matrix tuples with commutative semisimplification.

results.title: Read-k oblivious ABP PIT
results.question: For every fixed k, is white-box PIT for read-k oblivious ABPs over Q deterministic polynomial time?
results.result: Decide exact white-box PIT for read-k oblivious ABPs in polynomial time at fixed adjacency treewidth.

results.title: Dimension testing under succinct equation encoding
results.question: Place dimension testing of a rational affine variety whose defining polynomials are supplied by unrestricted arithmetic circuits in a fixed complexity class below PSPACE, with succinct degrees included in the parameter analysis.
results.result: Reduce dimension testing for unrestricted division-free circuits to explicit quadratic systems with a fixed counting-hierarchy bound.

results.title: Exponentiation of two coherent configurations
results.question: Define exponentiation X↑Y intrinsically for coherent configurations so that it agrees with group exponentiation whenever Y is the configuration of a permutation group.
results.result: Show that group exponentiation does not descend to orbital configurations and characterize sufficient orbit data.

results.title: Recognizing hidden Hamming fusions
results.question: For a primitive coherent configuration, find in polynomial time a nontrivial Hamming-scheme fusion and explicit product coordinates, or certify none exists.
results.result: Enumerate Hamming fusions with product coordinates in fixed-parameter time in the configuration rank.

results.title: Smallest forbidden minor giving count dependence
results.question: Determine the smallest order of a connected graph H whose own homomorphism count is determined by all H-minor-free tests, and classify the minimum-order cases.
results.result: Show that every connected forbidden minor on at most four vertices has an independent homomorphism count, giving a minimum order lower bound of five.

results.title: Polynomial-time legitimate vertex-deck recognition
results.question: Given n unlabeled candidate graphs on n-1 vertices, decide in polynomial time whether they form the vertex deck of a simple n-vertex graph, or prove a sharper complexity obstruction than known GI hardness.
results.result: Recognize vertex decks and list all preimages in fixed-parameter time in the smallest twin-class count of any card.

results.title: Canonical recovery with repeated eigenspaces
results.question: Construct a polynomial-time graph canonizer for a provably broad class having large repeated adjacency eigenspaces, using invariant auxiliary covariants rather than individual eigenvectors.
results.result: Canonize graphs when diagonal spectral projectors distinguish twin classes, even with repeated eigenvalues and unbounded quotient size.

results.title: Single-exponential homology localization by incidence width
results.question: Determine the best dependence on boundary-incidence treewidth for exact weighted 1-homology localization over a variable prime field whose elements are given in binary.
results.result: Give an exact width algorithm and prove binary-prime NP-hardness at constant width under Las Vegas reductions.

GP-0577.result: The regular lower bound and the published restriction give degree-n forms with border size n and exact size at least 1+ceil((n−6)²/2).

GP-0886.result: For n≥6 the separation degree on maximum-degree-two graphs is exactly ceil(n/2).
